system.health.telemetry.label: Share anonymous usage and crash reports
system.health.telemetry.help: Nothing leaves this computer unless you turn this on.

system.advanced.debug-mode.label: Record extra detail
system.advanced.debug-mode.help: Slows things a little; turn on only while chasing a problem.

system.advanced.log-verbosity.label: How much the logs record
system.advanced.log-verbosity.help: More detail helps support but fills the disk faster.

system.advanced.receipts-verbosity.label: Detail in the activity record
system.advanced.receipts-verbosity.help: Full keeps more but is harder to read.

system.advanced.runtime-artifacts.label: Show the app's working files
system.advanced.runtime-artifacts.help: Temporary files made while running; for odd behavior only.

system.advanced.cache-linter.label: Warn about changes that raise AI costs
system.advanced.cache-linter.help: Catches edits that stop prompt caching from working.

system.advanced.version-handshake.label: Check the app's parts match at startup
system.advanced.version-handshake.help: Stops with a clear message if they don't.

system.advanced.viewer-mode.label: Open read-only if another copy is running
system.advanced.viewer-mode.help: Stops two copies from overwriting each other.

system.advanced.renderer.label: Drawing engine
system.advanced.renderer.help: Change only if you see visual glitches.

system.advanced.reset-defaults.label: Reset settings to defaults
system.advanced.reset-defaults.help: Pick one setting, a section or everything; you see it first.
